name: Aiura Ichika
source: The student vice president. Is self proclaim S that believes others should follower her orders. Is rumor she has dirt/black mail on half the students/teachers. Doesn't get along with student president while similar selfish views as her, sees her as buffoon that can't help but poke fun of all her mistake/short comings. Despite taking pleasure in making others suffering doesn't have same feelings to those who don't deserve punishment.
